content.thinking: Journals 2462 and 2463 posted after their periods closed, and I'll verify journal 2464's reversal against journal 2416. Next I'll compare invoices with their journals, check for duplicate invoices, and match payments against invoices.

input.sql: select * from "GLJRNL" where "JRNL_NO" in (2416,2464) order by 1,2

select i."INV_ID",i."INV_NO",i."INV_AMT",i."JRNL_NO",i."STAT_CD",h."SRC_REF", (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') cr_ap,(select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") dr from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_AMT" <> coalesce((select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),-1) or trim(h."SRC_REF")<>trim(i."INV_NO")

select upper(regexp_replace(i."INV_NO",'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) k, trim(i."VEND_CD") v, count(*), array_agg(i."INV_ID"), array_agg(i."INV_NO"), array_agg(i."INV_AMT"), array_agg(i."INV_DT") from "APINVH" i group by 1,2 having count(*)>1
select p."PAY_ID",p."INV_ID",p."PAY_AMT",i."INV_AMT",p."PAY_DT",i."INV_DT" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
